scope: Off-diagonal covariance differentiation on t>r>0; does not certify a distributional identification or source proof
literal_covariance_matching: If CDST integrated input has covariance R_a(t,r)*gamma_CDST and the physical derivative target has |t-r|^(-a)*Gamma, use gamma_CDST=Gamma/[(1-a/2)(1-a)], or multiply the integrated input with gamma_CDST=Gamma by that coefficient^(-1/2).
normalization_boundary: This is a comparison of the displayed conventions, not a proposed correction to a source theorem. Matching only a Hurst parameter does not identify amplitudes or same-W regularizations.
